== Summary ==
[[Jonny Chu]] with [[Team Albany]] at [[DecipherCon 1999]] (Wild Card day, 11 November 1999). Photo: Decipher. Cropped from [[:File:Team Albany DecipherCon 1999.jpg]] (far right, white shirt).

Identification: Bill Bisco (personal communication, 25 October 2026) identified the one player not in a yellow Team Albany shirt as Jonny Chu. The face matches Chu in [[:File:Team Albany 2000 Team Championship.jpg]]. [[Matt Sokol]] confirmed him as the man in the white T-shirt (personal communication to Bill Bisco, 27 October 2026).
